description: This file implements the core logic for a DoorBell class, including network socket management, binding, unbinding, and event handling for inter-process or network communication within the WPEFramework. It defines the Connector nested class responsible for socket operations and the DoorBell class constructor and destructor.

classes.name: DoorBell::Connector
classes.description: Handles socket creation, binding, unbinding, and event handling for the DoorBell communication mechanism.

classes.name: DoorBell
classes.description: Represents a DoorBell object that manages network communication, initialized with a source name.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::Connector
methods.description: Constructor initializing socket parameters and setting non-blocking mode.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::~Connector
methods.description: Destructor closing sockets and cleaning up resources.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::Bind
methods.description: Creates and binds the socket, sets socket options, and registers the connector.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::Unbind
methods.description: Unregisters the connector and updates internal state.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::Descriptor
methods.description: Returns the handle to the socket for event polling.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::Events
methods.description: Returns the events to listen for, such as read readiness.

methods.name: DoorBell::Connector::Handle
methods.description: Handles the socket events, such as reading data.

methods.name: DoorBell::DoorBell
methods.description: Constructor initializing the DoorBell with a source name.

methods.name: DoorBell::~DoorBell
methods.description: Destructor signaling the event to stop operations.
